executionArgs.additionalInstruction: The backend server uses JWT authentication. To test authenticated endpoints like /api/command and /api/ocr/process, first call POST /api/auth/login with body {"email":"demo@harshita.ai","password":"demo123"} or POST /api/auth/register to get a JWT token. Use that token as Bearer token in Authorization header. The /health and /api/dashboard/stats endpoints do NOT require auth. Test all endpoints thoroughly.
